Check a lineage for spelling variants and inconsistent placements

Source: R/dv_lineage_check.R
dv_lineage_check.Rd

An offline check of the lineage attached to the prey, run before any figure is made. It flags two problems that split one taxon into several nodes of the tree, and so inflate the number of taxa and of threshold categories:

  • near_duplicate: two different labels at the same rank under the same parent whose spellings differ by at most max_dist edits (and by at most 10% of the length of the longer label). These are often an unaccepted spelling kept alongside the accepted name, e.g. a lineage frozen from an identifier that was not followed to its accepted record.

  • multi_parent: one label placed under more than one parent at the same rank, which gives that taxon two separate wedges.

It also flags genus_mismatch: a binomial at the finest rank whose first word differs from the genus.

Usage

dv_lineage_check(x, ranks = NULL, max_dist = 2L)

Arguments

x

A lineage data.frame (one row per prey key) or a dietview_prep from dv_prepare(). With a dietview_prep, the number of records carrying each flagged label is reported.

ranks

Rank columns, coarse to fine. Defaults to the ranks of the dietview_prep, or to kingdom..species for a lineage table.

max_dist

Largest edit distance (see utils::adist()) at which two labels are flagged as near duplicates.

Value

A data.frame with one row per flag: check, rank, parent, label, variant (the other spelling or the other parent), distance and n_records (NA for a lineage table). Zero rows when nothing is flagged.

Details

The check proposes; it does not repair. Correct the lineage table (or the matching against WoRMS with dv_prepare()(taxonomy = "worms"), which follows unaccepted AphiaIDs to their accepted record) and archive the corrected table with the results.

Examples

chk <- dv_lineage_check(ices_lineage)
chk[, c("check", "rank", "label", "variant")]
#>            check    rank                    label                  variant
#> 1 near_duplicate   genus                Aphrodita                Aphrodite
#> 2 near_duplicate species      Trisopterus esmarki     Trisopterus esmarkii
#> 3 near_duplicate species Lumpenus lampetraeformis Lumpenus lampretaeformis
